contracts.description: Lake Mariner ten-year leases, 438 MW aggregate
contracts.stage: 102 MW operational at Sep 30; remainder under construction
contracts.original_timing: Certain leases amended July from building to data-hall commencement.
contracts.current_timing: CB-4 phased Q4 2026; CB-5 phased early 2027.
contracts.recognition: Recognize straight-line fixed rent after commencement and variable power charges as incurred. Issuer does not identify per-hall rent in this model.

contracts.description: Justified initial three-building lease; EPC with Fluor
contracts.stage: Contract executed; Google credit support for project financing
contracts.original_timing: First hall late 2027; remaining halls through Q2 2028
contracts.recognition: Apply service timing to contracted $19bn base lease. Extensions and prospective financings excluded.

valuation.reason: No credible per-share target until project finance and incremental equity claims reconcile.
valuation.basis: Cash flows attributable to parent common after debt, preferred and minority claims. No external consensus is authenticated in this edition.

financing.reason: Bridge capacity is $500m with $100m drawn at September 30. The Google backstop supports anticipated project financing and is not proceeds. Dated obligations, draws and project-restricted uses are incomplete.

ownership_audit.history: Current five-session comparison uses the USD Nasdaq listing. Close and adjusted close agree on its two endpoints. The full historical corporate-action series remains unaudited.
ownership_audit.corporate_actions: December 2021 IKONICS merger included equity, a contingent value right and cash. Do not treat unadjusted pre-merger prices as WULF common.
ownership_audit.dilution: Quarter-end warrants and RSUs do not cover convertible debt or post-quarter project warrants. Do not add gross conversion shares and also retain full converted debt.

report.thesis: Lake Mariner has a measured rent stream. Justified has a tenant and construction contract, but rent depends on 2027–28 deliveries. Warrant remeasurement makes net income an unreliable check on cash conversion.
catalysts: CB-4 phased rent start in Q4 2026.
Remaining Abernathy sale installments due December 2026 and April 2027 subject to adjustments.
risks: New warrant dilution, time between capital spending and rent, and financing execution.
invalidation: CB-4/CB-5 miss revised phases or Justified permanent financing fails to close on acceptable terms.
missing: Project debt draw timing, gross-to-net rent and construction cost-to-complete by phase.
